blocks.html: Dutron CPVC Pipes & Fittings are manufactured using CPVC compound sourced from Sekisui Chemical Ltd., Japan — certified by NSF International (USA). Compatible with hot and cold water and can sustain up to 93°C. A dependable, cost-effective and long-lasting alternative to conventional GI and copper plumbing systems.

Long maintenance-free service life — corrosion resistant
Does not support combustion — ideal for fire safety systems
Complete range of pipes per IS 15778 & fittings per ASTM D 2846
Easy to install using solvent cement
CPVC compound sourced from Sekisui Chemical Ltd., Japan — NSF certified
Economical and long lasting replacement to GI/copper piping
Hot & Cold potable water distribution in residential, commercial & institutional buildings
Fire suppression systems (sprinklers) — due to fire resistance
